A veal cutlet rolled around ham and cheese, then breaded and fried; richer than a standard schnitzel.

Licitar

Tram
Blue trams are the simplest link between Lower Town, Maksimir and New Zagreb.
Zagreb has a tram system — operated by ZET. Lines used on this trip: 2, 6 and 13.

Day Trips by Train
Zaprešić · 30 min
A quick rail outing to the Lužnica and Novi Dvori estates, with parkland and historic buildings that make an easy half-day contrast to central Zagreb.
book at: Omio
Karlovac · 55 min
Explore the star-shaped historic centre at the meeting point of four rivers, then walk the riverfront before an easy same-day return to Zagreb.
book at: Omio
Varaždin · 1 hr 40 min
Spend the day among Baroque streets, colourful palaces and the Old Town fortress in one of northern Croatia’s most elegant small cities.
book at: Omio
Ljubljana · 2 hr 20 min
Cross into Slovenia for the riverside old town, Triple Bridge, market arcades and castle; check the international timetable carefully for the return.
book at: Omio
Rijeka · 3 hr 45 min
Use the longer rail day for Korzo, the hilltop Trsat complex and Kvarner Bay atmosphere, leaving generous margin for the final service back to Zagreb.
book at: Omio

Heads Up
Upper Town — Construction changes
Restoration work can close short stretches near St Mark’s Square and the western promenade; follow signed pedestrian diversions.
Dolac — Shop early
Outdoor produce stalls are liveliest in the morning and many traders pack up well before the posted market closing time.

Hiking packing checklist
Worth Knowing

Small rituals unlock the city

The cannon in Lotrščak Tower fires at noon, a brief daily signal that can be startling if you are standing on Strossmayer Promenade.

Café tables are meant for lingering. Order once, keep the table, and let Lower Town’s rhythm pass rather than treating coffee as a quick stop.

Paper tram tickets must be validated after boarding. The MojZET app also sells digital tickets, while kiosks remain the easiest backup.
